limitations.memory_scope: Whole GPU while benchmark client runs, including warmup and initial probe; excludes startup and can miss brief peaks.
limitations.token_length_scope: Lengths recorded by the native vLLM benchmark client; no per-request forwarding proxy is inserted.
limitations.repetition_scope: Repeated benchmark runs, not three independent machine or model-seed samples. A server may stay up between consecutive runs of the same model.
limitations.timing_scope: Warm local HTTP streaming service; model startup and compilation excluded; client-side timing includes HTTP/client overhead.
limitations.comparison_scope: One pruning width, one random channel seed, one GPU, two fixed workloads; no general speed guarantee.
limitations.statistical_plan: For each method/workload report all three run values, arithmetic mean and sample SD. Report ratios of mean throughput and differences of mean sampled maxima. Three repeats are descriptive; do not claim statistical significance.
